exoticPerks.name: Uncanny Arrows
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Grants Deadfall and Moebius Quiver energy.
exoticPerks.description: Provides ability energy for each target tethered by Deadfall anchors. Moebius Quiver has an additional shot.

descriptions.flavorText: Smother the lights and run.

exoticPerks.name: Winged Eclipse
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Loyal moths damage targets and aid your allies.
exoticPerks.description:
Defeat targets to charge up cages of loyal moths that fly toward nearby targets or allies.
 
[Grenade]  : Throw the cage of loyal moths, which are released on impact. Upon reaching targets, moths detonate in a blinding explosion; upon reaching allies, moths provide a Void overshield.

descriptions.flavorText: I am a shield unto myself.

exoticPerks.name: Clenched Fist
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Bonuses to guarding with Swords.
exoticPerks.description: Maximizes guard stats on equipped Heavy ammo Swords. You take reduced damage while blocking with a Sword. Rapidly damaging targets after blocking shots with a Sword grants Restoration for a duration determined by the number of shots blocked.

descriptions.flavorText: Reach the combustion point.

exoticPerks.name: Percussive Flames
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Burning Maul and Consecration create flame cyclones.
exoticPerks.description: Modifies Burning Maul into a single, high-damage slam of your hammer that creates several cyclones of flame. Consecration's second slam creates a cyclone of flame.

descriptions.flavorText: The ideocosm contained within this helm transforms the wearer's head from flesh and/or exoneurons to the pure, raw stuff of thought.

exoticPerks.name: Move to Survive
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Grants airborne movement and improves Blink.
exoticPerks.description:
With Blink equipped, use [Air Dodge]  while airborne to perform a Dark Blink.

Using Blink or Dark Blink grants Volatile Rounds. Blink travels farther, causes nearby targets to become volatile, and has a shorter cooldown. While your Nova Warp Super is active, Dark Blink does not cost Super energy. Provides a moderate benefit to airborne effectiveness for all weapons.

descriptions.flavorText: "To gain power, you must sacrifice. Exos have known this long before the Guardians' rise."  —Taeko-3

exoticPerks.name: Grasp of the Devourer
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Melee hits inflict potent corruption that deals increasing damage over time.
exoticPerks.description:
Damaging a target with a melee inflicts potent corruption that deals increasing damage over time. Defeating targets afflicted by corruption spreads the condition.

Provides a moderate benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all Weapons of Sorrow.

Using Blink or Dark Blink grants Volatile Rounds. Blink travels farther, causes nearby targets to become volatile, and has a shorter cooldown. While your Nova Warp Super is active, Dark Blink does not cost Super energy. Provides a moderate benefit to airborne effectiveness for all weapons.

descriptions.flavorText: "To gain power, you must sacrifice. Exos have known this long before the Guardians' rise."  —Taeko-3

exoticPerks.name: Grasp of the Devourer
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Melee hits inflict potent corruption that deals increasing damage over time.
exoticPerks.description:
Damaging a target with a melee inflicts potent corruption that deals increasing damage over time. Defeating targets afflicted by corruption spreads the condition.

Provides a moderate benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all Weapons of Sorrow.

descriptions.flavorText: Never, ever, look back.

exoticPerks.name: Uncanny Arrows
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Grants Deadfall and Moebius Quiver energy.
exoticPerks.description: Provides ability energy for each target tethered by Deadfall anchors. Moebius Quiver has an additional shot.

descriptions.flavorText: Smother the lights and run.

exoticPerks.name: Winged Eclipse
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Loyal moths damage targets and aid your allies.
exoticPerks.description:
Defeat targets to charge up cages of loyal moths that fly toward nearby targets or allies.
 
[Grenade]  : Throw the cage of loyal moths, which are released on impact. Upon reaching targets, moths detonate in a blinding explosion; upon reaching allies, moths provide a Void overshield.

descriptions.flavorText: I am a shield unto myself.

exoticPerks.name: Clenched Fist
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Bonuses to guarding with Swords.
exoticPerks.description: Maximizes guard stats on equipped Heavy ammo Swords. You take reduced damage while blocking with a Sword. Rapidly damaging targets after blocking shots with a Sword grants Restoration for a duration determined by the number of shots blocked.

descriptions.flavorText: Reach the combustion point.

exoticPerks.name: Percussive Flames
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Burning Maul and Consecration create flame cyclones.
exoticPerks.description: Modifies Burning Maul into a single, high-damage slam of your hammer that creates several cyclones of flame. Consecration's second slam creates a cyclone of flame.

descriptions.flavorText: The ideocosm contained within this helm transforms the wearer's head from flesh and/or exoneurons to the pure, raw stuff of thought.
